questions.question:
Assertion ( A ) : Spontaneous generation theorey was dismissed once and for all 
Reason ( R ) Oparin & Haldane proposed chemical evolution of life
questions.option_a: Both A & R are True & R is the correct explanation of A
questions.option_b: Both A & R are True & R is not  the correct explanation of A
questions.option_c: A is true But R is false
questions.explanation:
Assertion (A): Spontaneous generation theory was dismissed once and for all.
✅ True — The theory of spontaneous generation was conclusively disproved by Louis Pasteur through his swan-neck flask experiment.

Reason (R): Alexander Oparin and J. B. S. Haldane proposed the chemical evolution of life.
✅ True — They proposed that life originated from non-living matter through a gradual process of chemical evolution under primitive Earth conditions.

However, the reason does not explain the assertion. Pasteur's experiments disproved spontaneous generation, while Oparin and Haldane proposed a separate hypothesis about the origin of the first life through chemical evolution.

Correct Answer:
✅ Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
